# Vendored Tabletop dependency

`begame-tabletop-0.1.16.tgz` was packed from the installed `@begame/tabletop` 0.1.16 in the sibling ddz workspace. Its lockfile identifies the source as `https://github.com/ykxyx666/tabletop.git` at commit `c4cec95316a4b635662f1c36aab8511a5a26d83d`. The tarball SHA-512 is recorded in the root package lockfile.

The installed Tabletop package declares itself private and contains no license declaration or license file; no license is inferred here. Its bundled `@begame/trace` and `@begame/trace-spec` packages include their own MIT license files inside the archive.
